en.name: Flaxseed, ground
en.summary: Ground flaxseed keeps 12 months from purchase in the refrigerator at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, and 12 months in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F). It is stored cold rather than in a cupboard because the oil in it is among the most fragile in the store cupboard.
en.pantry: There is no cupboard timeline for ground flaxseed, and that is deliberate. Flax oil is very highly unsaturated, and grinding the seed exposes all of it to air at once — which is why milled flax is sold in light-proof, often vacuum or nitrogen-flushed packs and why it goes bitter and fishy at room temperature much faster than most seeds. Whole flaxseed is a different matter and keeps well in a cupboard; if you want a long shelf life, buy it whole and grind small batches as you need them.
en.fridge: 12 months from purchase at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, in an opaque airtight container. Cold and dark together are what slow the oxidation, so an old jam jar on a bright shelf is not the answer — use something light-proof, or keep the jar inside a tin. Ground flax is also absorbent and will take up fridge odours, so seal it hard, and let the container warm to room temperature before opening it so condensation does not settle on the meal.
en.freezer: 12 months at −18 °C (0 °F), the same figure as the fridge, so use the freezer for the bulk and the fridge for the jar you are actually working through. It scoops straight from frozen without thawing, since there is very little water in it. Bag it airtight with the air pressed out, portion it, and keep the pack sealed while it warms if you take it out, to keep condensation off.
en.thawing: No thawing is needed — use it straight from the freezer. Let the sealed container reach room temperature before opening if you have taken out the whole pack.
spoilage: A bitter, fishy or paint-like smell — flax oil goes off distinctively.
A bitter aftertaste in bread or porridge made with it.
Clumping or caking, meaning moisture has got in.
Mould or a musty smell in a pack that got damp.
tips: Buy whole seed and grind small batches if you want a long shelf life.
Store in an opaque airtight container; light matters as much as heat.
Keep the working jar in the fridge and the rest in the freezer.
Smell it before baking with it — the bitterness carries into the finished loaf.

faq.q: How long does ground flaxseed keep?
faq.a: 12 months from purchase in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, or 12 months in the freezer at −18 °C.

faq.q: Can you keep ground flaxseed in a cupboard?
faq.a: No cupboard timeline is given for it. The oil is very fragile once the seed is milled, so it is stored cold. Whole flaxseed keeps well in a cupboard.

faq.q: How can you tell if ground flaxseed has gone bad?
faq.a: Smell it. Rancid flax smells bitter and distinctly fishy, and the taste carries straight into whatever you bake with it.

zh.name: 亞麻仁籽粉
zh.summary: 亞麻仁籽粉自購買日起，冷藏 4 °C 以下可放 12 個月，冷凍 −18 °C 下同樣是 12 個月。它之所以放冷藏而不是櫥櫃，是因為它的油脂是這一櫃裡最脆弱的那一類。
zh.pantry: 亞麻仁籽粉沒有櫥櫃的期限，而這是刻意的。亞麻油高度不飽和，而研磨等於把裡面的油一次全部攤在空氣中——這就是為什麼市售亞麻籽粉都用遮光、甚至真空或充氮的包裝，也是為什麼它在室溫下發苦、發腥的速度比多數種子快得多。整粒亞麻仁則是另一回事，放櫥櫃很耐放；想要長保存期，就買整粒、要用多少磨多少。
zh.fridge: 遮光的氣密容器放 4 °C 以下，自購買日起 12 個月。真正拖慢氧化的是「低溫加避光」，所以把它裝在舊果醬罐、放在明亮的層架上並不是答案——請用不透光的容器，或把罐子再放進鐵盒裡。亞麻籽粉也很會吸味道，密封要確實；拿出來時要等容器回到室溫再打開，才不會結露在粉上。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下 12 個月，和冷藏是同一個數字，所以合理的分工是：大量放冷凍，日常在用的那一罐放冷藏。它含水極少，可以直接從冷凍挖取、不必解凍。請密封裝袋、把空氣壓出並分裝；如果整包拿出來，請維持密封直到回溫，避免結露。
zh.thawing: 不需要解凍，直接從冷凍取用。若整包拿出來，請密封著回到室溫再打開。
spoilage: 聞起來發苦、有魚腥味或像油漆——亞麻油走味的特徵很明顯。
用它做的麵包或粥有明顯苦後味。
結塊、結成硬團，代表水氣跑進去了。
受潮的包裝長霉或有霉味。
tips: 想要長保存期就買整粒，要用多少磨多少。
用不透光的氣密容器，光線和溫度一樣重要。
日常用的小罐放冷藏，其餘放冷凍。
烘焙前先聞一下，苦味會原封不動進到成品裡。

faq.q: 亞麻仁籽粉可以放多久？
faq.a: 自購買日起冷藏 4 °C 以下 12 個月，或 −18 °C 冷凍 12 個月。

faq.q: 亞麻仁籽粉可以放櫥櫃嗎？
faq.a: 它沒有櫥櫃的期限。磨粉後油脂非常脆弱，所以要低溫保存。整粒亞麻仁放櫥櫃則很耐放。

faq.q: 怎麼判斷亞麻仁籽粉壞了？
faq.a: 用聞的。走味的亞麻籽粉發苦、帶明顯魚腥味，而那個味道會直接進到烘焙成品裡。
